mobile.paste.title: Clipboard
mobile.paste.error: Could not read the clipboard (permission denied or unavailable).
mobile.help.title: Mobile bar
mobile.help.intro: The mobile bar puts the keys that are usually missing from a phone keyboard within reach. It also opens both side panels so you can move around the entire console without leaving the session.
mobile.help.first.title: First steps
mobile.help.first.step1: Open a Terminal or a conversation in TUI mode; the bar is not shown in visual Chat.
mobile.help.first.step2: Tap the ⌨ handle to expand the auxiliary keys.
mobile.help.first.step3: Use the keys, paste, or open “abc” to dictate and send text.
mobile.help.first.step4: Tap the left handle to open modules or the right one to open Sessions.
mobile.help.first.step5: Choose a session or action, then tap outside the drawer to return to the content.
mobile.help.legend.title: Legend
mobile.help.legend.keyboard.name: Keyboard handle
mobile.help.legend.keyboard.desc: expands or hides the auxiliary bar
mobile.help.legend.modules.name: Left handle
mobile.help.legend.sessions.name: Right handle
mobile.help.legend.clipboard.name: Clipboard
mobile.help.legend.clipboard.desc: pastes text into the active terminal
mobile.help.legend.active.name: Highlighted control
mobile.help.legend.active.desc: accent border and text show that Ctrl, abc, or Enter is active
mobile.help.actions.title: Buttons and actions
mobile.help.actions.handle.v: Shows or hides the key row and focuses the terminal again when opened.
mobile.help.actions.esc.v: Cancels or exits the current mode of the application running in the terminal.
mobile.help.actions.tab.v: Sends Tab: completes commands or moves to the next field.
mobile.help.actions.shiftTab.v: Sends Shift+Tab: moves back through fields or changes mode if the application uses it.
mobile.help.actions.ctrl.v: Stays armed: the next character is sent as Ctrl+character, then it turns off automatically.
mobile.help.actions.ctrlC.v: Sends Ctrl+C to interrupt the foreground process.
mobile.help.actions.slash.v: Types a slash; in a TUI, it starts slash commands.
mobile.help.actions.paste.v: Reads and pastes the clipboard with browser permission.
mobile.help.actions.dictate.v: Opens or closes the regular text and dictation field.
mobile.help.actions.input.v: Accepts typed or dictated text before sending it to the terminal.
mobile.help.actions.enter.v: When active, adds Enter to the send; when off, it pastes the text without running it.
mobile.help.actions.send.v: Sends the text to the terminal. In a TUI, sending a request with Enter may trigger a response that consumes tokens.
mobile.help.actions.leftHandle.v: Opens Tickets, Tasks, Continuous Improvement, and the footer shortcuts.
mobile.help.actions.rightHandle.v: Opens New session, Sessions, Tolkien, and server status.
mobile.help.navigation.title: Navigating from your phone
mobile.help.navigation.left.v: Use it to access modules, boards, and general tools.
mobile.help.navigation.right.v: Use it to create a session, review states, and switch to another conversation or terminal.
mobile.help.navigation.close.v: Closes the open drawer and returns focus to the central area.
mobile.help.warning.title: Watch out for this
mobile.help.warning.text: ^C interrupts the active process. Pasting or dictating with ⏎ enabled adds Enter, so it can run a command or send a request to Claude immediately; turn it off if you want to review the text first.
